verdict.rationale: Evidence shows general OAuth 2.0/mTLS authentication (jeeves-docs-8) and an MCP server for agent access (jeeves-docs-13/33), but there is no documentation of scoped, least-privilege, or agent-specific API credential/token issuance (e.g., granular scopes, per-agent API keys, or permission tiers). Missing for 10: scoped API key/token creation mechanism, documented permission granularity for agent credentials, any least-privilege access control model for machine/agent identities.
